_guide.structure: Add achievements below using their numeric ID as the key.

achievements.name: Hello, World!
achievements.condition: Complete all tutorial levels (beat Level 4).

achievements.name: Who Made This?
achievements.condition: Visit the Credits page.

achievements.name: Customization
achievements.condition: Visit the Options page.

achievements.name: SOS Request
achievements.condition: Attempt to join the Discord server.

achievements.name: Pilgrimage
achievements.condition: Visit the Hall of Fame page.

achievements.name: まさか?
achievements.condition: Enter 'hidden' in Level 4. (Enter the most commonly used password into the first password field.)

achievements.name: Procrastination
achievements.condition: Click the button in Level 7 before clearing away every object.

achievements.name: Totally Newbie
achievements.condition: Reach the first Warp Zone (beat Level 8).

achievements.name: First Flight
achievements.condition: Use the Warp Zone for the first time.

achievements.name: The Great Progress Reset
achievements.condition: Click 'back' or 'rewind' in the Level 9 menu.

achievements.name: OEM is Best
achievements.condition: Enter 'dark purple' in Level 12.

achievements.name: Almost Not a Newbie
achievements.condition: Reach the second Warp Zone (beat Level 14).

achievements.name: Same Meaning, Right?
achievements.condition: Enter 'hide', 'hidden', or '?????' in Level 15.

achievements.name: Tunnel Vision
achievements.condition: Enter '22' or '4.58203125' in Level 16. (Interpret 16 or coffee as hexadecimal.)

achievements.name: SKIP +1
achievements.condition: Attempt to move to another level from Level 17. (Try to visit a strange level instead of the next one.)

achievements.name: Haven't I Seen This Level Before?
achievements.condition: Click the button at (242, 242) in Level 19 without clicking the button at (19, 19) first.

achievements.name: Hard, but Manageable
achievements.condition: Reach the third Warp Zone (beat Level 19).

achievements.name: A New Idea
achievements.condition: Enter 'neddih' in Level 20, Scene 2.

achievements.name: The One That Took Over Computers Worldwide (Except Linux)
achievements.condition: Enter 'arial' in Level 20, Scene 3.

achievements.name: Cassiopeia
achievements.condition: Press 'w' on the keyboard in Level 20, Scene 5.

achievements.name: ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
achievements.condition: Enter 'awesome face' or 'epic smiley' in Level 20, Scene 6.

achievements.name: NELG LOVER
achievements.condition: Click the button at (20, 20) or (242, 242) in Level 20, Scene 7.

achievements.name: リセマラ
achievements.condition: Click 'back' or 'rewind' in the Level 20, Scene 9 menu.

achievements.name: I Told You It Wouldn't Work!!!
achievements.condition: Attempt to move to another level from Level 20, Scene 10. (Try to visit a strange level instead of the next one.)

achievements.name: Finger Princess
achievements.condition: Use copy and paste to enter '3' in Level 21 before pressing '3' on the keyboard.

achievements.name: Still a Great Answer, but Not What I Wanted
achievements.condition: Enter 'EBOI' in Level 22.

achievements.name: The First Trial
achievements.condition: Reach the fourth Warp Zone (beat Level 22).

achievements.name: Why?
achievements.condition: Enter '?' in Level 23.

achievements.name: You Just Activated My Trap Card
achievements.condition: Enter 'hidden' in the password field in Level 24.

achievements.name: Maze Anorexia
achievements.condition: Enter 'hidden' on the keyboard in Level 25 without pressing every button in the maze.

achievements.name: Patience Reinforcement Learning
achievements.condition: Reach the fifth Warp Zone (beat Level 25).

achievements.name: Are You Included Too?
achievements.condition: Enter 'hidden.' or '*******' in Level 26.

achievements.name: Deal with the Devil
achievements.condition: Make '666' in Level 27.

achievements.name: Roll Safe
achievements.condition: Reach the sixth Warp Zone (beat Level 29).

achievements.name: No thoughts, head empty
achievements.condition: Enter 'THIRTY' in Level 30.

achievements.name: Doppelgänger
achievements.condition: Enter 'WEIB' in Level 31.

achievements.name: Heart of the Beast
achievements.condition: Reach Scene 9 in Level 32 without dying once.

achievements.name: Nexus
achievements.condition: Reach the seventh Warp Zone (beat Level 32).

achievements.name: RGB
achievements.condition: Click Stop, Pause, and Play in that order in Level 34. (Press the buttons in the same order as the door colors in Level 20.)

achievements.name: Sneak 100
achievements.condition: Enter '*********' in Level 35, Scene 2.

achievements.name: Press X to Doubt
achievements.condition: Enter 'pedestrian' in Level 35, Scene 4. (Even though you were told that the hint was not meant for this scene...)

achievements.name: 64 bits... 32 bits... 16 bits...
achievements.condition: Make 16 in Level 35, Scene 5. (You remembered the exact line from Level 16!)

achievements.name: IDGAF
achievements.condition: Enter 'DO YOU STILL REMEMBER?' in Level 35, Scene 7.

achievements.name: Silent Hill
achievements.condition: Press the Play button in Level 35, Scene 9 while the volume is set to 0.

achievements.name: hakótel hama'araví
achievements.condition: Reach the eighth Warp Zone (beat Level 35).
